name: example-plugin
description: Reference plugin: config args, a pre-model-load banner, and a heartbeat TrainerCallback.

checks.name: plugin-instantiates-and-declares-its-args
checks.run: python -c "from axolotl_example_plugin import ExamplePlugin; p = ExamplePlugin(); assert p.get_input_args() == 'axolotl_example_plugin.args.ExamplePluginArgs'"

checks.name: heartbeat-callback-is-a-trainercallback
checks.run: python -c "from axolotl_example_plugin.callback import ExampleHeartbeatCallback; from transformers import TrainerCallback; assert issubclass(ExampleHeartbeatCallback, TrainerCallback)"
